description: Implementation of the SatToken class managing security tokens, including retrieval, storage, and event handling for token updates within the TTS plugin of WPEFramework.

classes.name: SatToken
classes.description: Manages security tokens, including fetching, updating, and event subscription for token changes.

methods.name: SatToken::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of SatToken for a given callsign.

methods.name: SatToken::SatToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SatToken object with a callsign.

methods.name: SatToken::getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves the security token, reading environment variables, config files, or calling external functions.

methods.name: SatToken::getSAT
methods.description: Returns the current SAT token, refetching if it has been marked as updated.

methods.name: SatToken::getServiceAccessToken
methods.description: Invokes the external service to get a new service access token and subscribes to token change events.

methods.name: SatToken::serviceAccessTokenChangedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles the event when the service access token is updated.
